ISL 2026-27: Table-topper Mohun Bagan eyes fourth straight win as it hosts Odisha FC
 Sitting at the top of the standings with nine points from four matches, former champion Mohun Bagan will be eager to collect another three points and consolidate its position in the title race.
 Updated : Nov 04, 2026 21:09 IST , KOLKATA - 4 MINS READ 
 Amitabha Das Sharma

 Mohun Bagan Super Giant will look to extend its winning run when it hosts Odisha FC in an important Indian Super League (ISL) 2026-27 fixture at the Salt Lake Stadium in Kolkata on Thursday.
 The Mariners head into the contest on the back of three consecutive wins and a perfect home record so far this season. Sitting at the top of the standings with nine points from four matches, the former champion will be eager to collect another three points and consolidate its position in the title race.
 However, a growing list of injury concerns could pose a challenge for head coach Panagiotis Dilmperis. Sahal Abdul Samad has been a new addition to the list of doubtful starters and has joined the names like Jamie Maclaren, Miguel Figueira and Lalengmawia Ralte (Apuia), who have missed a significant part of the campaign.
 Dilmperis is keen to ensure that the impressive run does not breed complacency. Acknowledging the expectations surrounding the city giant, the Greek tactician has stressed the need for greater intensity, particularly on home soil. “We have to be more aggressive at home,” he said ahead of the encounter.
 The coach has reasons to demand a more emphatic performance from his side. Despite maintaining a perfect home record, Mohun Bagan has had to work hard for its wins, edging past Chennaiyin FC 1-0 and Punjab FC 2-1. A more clinical display in the final third will be high on Dilmperis’ agenda against an Odisha side struggling for confidence.
 The Juggernauts arrive in Kolkata still searching for their first victory of the campaign. Head coach T.G. Purushothaman faces the difficult task of lifting a side that has struggled to find consistency in the opening phase of the season. Odisha has a 33-member squad, including five foreign players, offering Purushothaman a range of options. However, converting that squad depth into consistent performances and, more importantly, wins remains the immediate challenge.
 ALSO READ | SAFF Championship 2026 – Why champion India shouldn’t take Pakistan and Maldives lightly in Bangladesh 
 From a tactical standpoint, containing Mohun Bagan’s attacking threat will be Odisha’s biggest challenge. The visitor will need to remain organised at the back and restrict the space available to the Mariners’ forwards, while avoiding the defensive lapses that could prove costly. Lee Erwin, Manvir Singh and Serbian forward Dejan Drazic offer the home side viable attacking options.
 On the other hand, Odisha, which sits in the 10th spot with two points from three matches, will look towards Brazilian forward Everton Nascimento and Palestinian attacker Mahmoud Eid to provide the attacking spark. Indian internationals Nandhakumar Sekar and Rahim Ali will also be expected to contribute in the final third. Their ability to exploit gaps in the Mohun Bagan defence could be crucial if the visitor is to threaten an upset.
 On paper, Mohun Bagan enjoys the advantage of superior form, home support and attacking depth. This is contrasted with Odisha’s desperate need for points, making the contest interesting if the visitor can combine defensive discipline with greater purpose in attack.
 Churchill Brothers hosts NorthEast United
 Earlier in the day, Churchill Brothers will take on NorthEast United at the Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium in Fatorda.
 Churchill will be looking to bounce back from back-to-back defeats against East Bengal FC and Punjab FC after opening its campaign with a 2-1 win against Mumbai City FC.
 Its head coach, Dimitris Dimitriou, acknowledged that individual mistakes have hurt his side and hopes his players can respond in front of their home supporters.
 “I hope we are able to make fewer mistakes in the next game, and we give the happiness and the smiles back to our fans and our management,” Dimitriou said.
 NorthEast United, meanwhile, is unbeaten this season and sits second in the table with eight points from four games, one behind leader Mohun Bagan. The Highlanders’ attack has been driven by Moroccan forward Alaaeddine Ajaraie and winger Jithin MS, who have scored two goals each so far, while they have just conceded two goals this season.
 This will be the second meeting between the two sides after they faced each other in the 2023 Super Cup in Kozhikode, with NorthEast walking away with a 6-3 win.
